title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
hook_before: OpenAI just missed its revenue target by twenty billion dollars.
script:
OpenAI missed its revenue target by twenty billion dollars.
TechCrunch reported the annualized revenue sits way below previous projections.
Earlier estimates claimed the AI lab brought in seventy billion dollars.
The massive drop raises questions about how fast artificial intelligence can monetize.
Can OpenAI fix this gap before investors demand profits?
